# Next.js Documentation

> Reference and guides for Next.js 16.4.3 — the React framework for building full-stack web applications.

## [Getting Started](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/getting-started)

- [Installation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/getting-started/installation): Learn how to create a new Next.js application.
- [Project Structure](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/getting-started/project-structure): Learn the folder and file conventions in Next.js.
